P. (लुभ्यति, लुब्ध) 
__1 To covet, long for, desire eagerly (with dat. or loc.); तथापि रामो लुलुभे मृगाय. 
__2 To allure, entice. 
__3 To be bewidered or perplexed, go astray. -Caus. (लोभयति-ते) 
__1 To make greedy, cause to long for, produce or excite desire for; पुप्लुवे बहु लोभयन् [[

.]] 
__2 To excite lust. 
__3 To entice, seduce, allure, [Page1369-2] attract; लोभ्यमाननयनः श्लथांशुकैर्मेखलागुणपदैर्नितम्बिभिः [[
